question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn/plugin-owned or fold into scheduled-job routing?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix shape changes public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, model/provider precedence, session-state behavior, and plugin/core ownership, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Per-Turn Plugin Routing
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless maintainers accept a new task execution boundary.

options.title: Add Native HEARTBEAT.md Fields
options.body: Define model/provider task fields and implement grouped or split due-task execution with explicit validation, timestamp, and session-state rules.

options.title: Fold Into Scheduled-Job Routing
options.body: Make the cron/job-level override track the canonical scheduled model-selection API and avoid a heartbeat-specific syntax until cron and heartbeat semantics converge.

recommendation.title: Keep Per-Turn Plugin Routing
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless maintainers accept a new task execution boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the current blamed heartbeat batching and model-override lines, making him the best available source-history owner for the runtime/API choice.
